data.name: Bonus Druid Spell
data.description: [Oracle] An oracle with the nature or wood mystery adds %1 spells from the druid's spell list that isn't on the cleric spell list to the oracle's spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the oracle can cast.|LeshyOracleBonusDruidSpellCount
